title: CULLING MISINFORMATION FROM GEN AI: Toward Ethical Curation and Refinement

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation and conceptual analysis highlighting how generative AI, specifically deepfake technology, is disproportionately weaponized against female figures (e.g., nonconsensual explicit content of celebrities).
Conceptual discussion addressing how biased training datasets strengthen existing stereotypes and marginalize racial minorities, perpetuating systemic inequity.
Literature review evaluating how biases in AI systems trained on non-representative medical data can lead to diagnostic and treatment disparities across different patient populations.
